description: Translate text on your device with ONNX models (Opus-MT, M2M100): a side bar, editor commands and an API for other extensions.
view.title: Translator
cmd.translateFile: Translate File into a New Editor
cfg.sourceLanguage: The language to translate from: a code, or auto to tell it by the letters of the text.
cfg.targetLanguage: The language to translate into (a code). Empty: the language of VS Code.
cfg.alternateLanguage: The language to translate into when the text is in the target language already.
cfg.beams: How many variants the search keeps (1 is fastest; 0: what each model is made with).
cfg.idleMinutes: Models are freed from memory after this many minutes without work (0: never).
cfg.models: The folders of the translation models, downloaded in the side bar or chosen on the disk.
cfg.inactiveModels: The folders of the models that translations do not use: those unchecked in the side bar.
